_note: architecture-reference-component-coverage (board SkGemmaPlaat): the GEMMA plate, a child of Reports & Compliance (ADR-097: no new top-level entry). A custom page because it renders one organisation-scoped, bounded join of usages and GEMMA reference components (GET /api/reference-component-coverage), which no facet can express: a component nobody uses has no bucket.

pages.title: GEMMA plate
pages._note: A plate, not a list: the GEMMA reference components grouped as the GEMMA model groups them, each with the applications the organisation uses for it and its state (covered, gap or overlap), from one organisation-scoped GET /api/reference-component-coverage answer. No standard page type renders grouped coverage like this.
